# workspace manifest
[package]
name = "zeron"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = 2024
authors = ["A <a@example.com>"]

[dependencies]
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"], optional = true }

[[bin]]
path = 'src/main.rs'
date = 1979-05-27T07:32:00Z
pi = 3.14
flag = false

# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1
FROM alpine:3.19 AS build
ARG VERSION=1.0
ENV PATH="/app/bin:$PATH" LANG=C.UTF-8
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=build --chown=app:app ./src /app/src
RUN apk add --no-cache curl && \
    echo "building $VERSION" > /tmp/log
RUN <<EOT
set -e
echo heredoc
EOT
COPY <<EOT /etc/config.json
{"key": "value", "n": 1}
EOT
EXPOSE 8080/tcp
HEALTHCHECK CMD curl -f http://localhost/ || exit 1
ENTRYPOINT ["/app/bin/zeron", "--serve"]
CMD ["--port", "8080"]

# Makefile comment
CC ?= gcc
CFLAGS := -O2 -Wall
SRC = $(wildcard src/*.c)
OBJ = $(SRC:.c=.o)
export PATH

.PHONY: all clean

all: app

app: $(OBJ)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -o $@ $^

%.o: %.c
	@echo "compiling $<"
	$(CC) -c $< -o $@

clean:
	rm -f $(OBJ) app

ifeq ($(DEBUG),1)
CFLAGS += -g
endif
include config.mk
